hooks.name: Keep the tree green before a task starts
hooks.description: Blocks a spec task from starting (exit 2) while make verify-quick is failing. Fix the build in a normal chat first. Set enabled to false to bypass in an emergency.

action.prompt: Before writing code for this task: (1) read docs/STATUS.md; (2) read every requirement ID and the design section this task references; (3) list the exact files you will touch, which must match the task's 'Files' list; (4) restate the acceptance commands you will run. If anything needed is missing (data, config value, contract detail), stop and add a 'Blocked:' entry to docs/STATUS.md instead of guessing.

Before declaring this task done: (1) run every acceptance command listed in the task and `make verify-quick`, and show the result; (2) confirm no NaN was replaced by a number and no contract in data-contracts.md was changed; (3) append one log line to docs/STATUS.md in the format from agent-rules.md, including the model name; (4) tick the task checkbox only if everything passed, otherwise mark it partial and explain.
